title: A Comet
text: A comet low in the west after sunset, a pale tail with a kink in it.

lines.text: "Comet Varro. A long period, very long: by the survey it comes round about once a run. If the hull field is right about how long a run lasts, it was here for the last one. And the one before."
"It is. I'd like it a great deal more if it were late."

notes: The comet's return without the Vell (no keeper-song).
